card.name: Subject before keep-away verbs
card.fires_on: A subject, or a word just after it, where the sentence is heading toward repelling, deterring or staying away. It marks the spot right before verbs like off, away, spit out, unwilling, or not eat.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about staying, as in staying away or staying out, and away from words about excluding.
